# Fab outputs (generated by scripts/gen_fab.py)

- `jlcpcb/megabank-gerbers.zip`: 4-layer Gerbers (F, In1 = GND, In2 = +3V3, B; paste, silk, mask, edge) and Excellon drill + map.
- `jlcpcb/megabank-bom.csv`, `jlcpcb/megabank-cpl.csv`: JLCPCB assembly BOM and placement (top side; all mm, KiCad rotations).
- Not in the BOM/CPL (not assembled): FID1, FID2, FID3.
- BOM lines with no LCSC number (pick at upload): none.
- U23 (ME6211C12, SOT-23-5) supplies the RP2350B core (DVDD, 1.2 V); the chip's own switcher is unused (no inductor). Pin 1 is VIN: check its dot in the placement preview.
- BT1 is the Keystone 3034TR (C5213768), as on the OpenSpand card; the Q&J CR2032-BS-6-1 (C70377) forced Standard PCBA. If stock runs out, leave it off and fit a Keystone 3034 (DigiKey 36-3034-ND) by hand.
- DNP (footprint only): R3 (/BE pull-up, open question 13). R13/R14 are fitted for the CY62167EV30; leave them off for a DV30 build.
- All drills are 0.3 mm or larger; all vias 0.6/0.3 mm.
- Check rotations in JLCPCB's placement preview: JLC's part orientation differs from KiCad's for many footprints (QFN, SOT-223, SOIC, connectors); fix there, not here.
- Upload order: PCB first (4 layers, 1.6 mm, ENIG recommended for the edge fingers, chamfered gold fingers optional), then assembly with the BOM and CPL.
